owner_and_source: Massachusetts Bay Transportation Authority (MBTA) public GTFS-Realtime feed, VehiclePositions (cdn.mbta.com/realtime/VehiclePositions.pb) -- a real, live, keyless agency feed
license_and_commercial_rights: MassDOT Developers License Agreement (the developer data license governing all MBTA/MassDOT open data feeds; no API key required for the cdn.mbta.com/realtime/*.pb feeds). The agreement grants use of the published open data feeds -- these feeds are used commercially by major transit apps -- subject to attribution to MassDOT/MBTA and the agreement's warranty-disclaimer terms. Commercial-use permission is set by that agreement; its full PDF text was not machine-verifiable at acquisition time (mass.gov download returned 403) and must be reviewed before any promotion beyond Demonstrated.
geography: Greater Boston, Massachusetts, USA (MBTA service area)
time_coverage: point-in-time snapshot of a continuously-updating real-time feed (captured at acquisition)
schema_and_format: GTFS-Realtime FeedMessage in binary protobuf (.pb): VehiclePosition entities (live location, current_status, stop_id, occupancy, timestamp). Parsed via the official gtfs-realtime-bindings FeedMessage.ParseFromString. GTFS-Realtime is the operational real-time counterpart to static GTFS.
update_frequency: continuous (real-time; the live feed refreshes every few seconds). source_checksum is null and records the sha256 of THIS captured snapshot as provenance, not a reproducibility guarantee -- a later fetch will differ.
canonical_contract: themis.canonical.entities.Outcome (a STOPPED_AT VehiclePosition -> an observed-arrival Outcome; see themis/connect/gtfs_realtime.py and the operational-entity gap flagged for ADR 0030+)

quality_tests.name: parses_as_feedmessage
quality_tests.description: retained object parses as a GTFS-Realtime FeedMessage with at least one VehiclePosition entity

acceptance_threshold: downloads, non-empty, parses as a GTFS-Realtime FeedMessage containing VehiclePosition entities
retention_and_deletion: retain as part of the standards-adapter certification corpus; a re-captured snapshot supersedes it. A real-time snapshot, not a fixed reference object, so evictable first.
